copy.subject: {{ first_name|default:'friend' }}, A little help with those gifts for the ones who mean the most 🎁
copy.preview: For the ones who matter most, and you never know what they want ❤️
intro:
There's something about this time of year that 
makes you want to slow down and
appreciate the people around you, 
isn't there? 
🎄

But then comes the actual gift buying, 
and suddenly you're staring at a screen,
 wondering what on earth to get
 for the parent who says they don't need anything, 
or the friend whose home is already perfect.

That's where personalised wall art
 has quietly become
 one of my favourite answers. 
Beautiful personalised wall art, with family names
 chosen with someone in mind,
feels considered in a way that a voucher 
or a scented candle simply doesn't.
🌟

If you'd like a hand picking something for someone specific, 
just hit reply and tell me a little about them. I'm genuinely happy to help. 😊
copy.closingText:
Wishing you a warm, 
unhurried run-up to Christmas...
